description: Client-side script for initializing and managing terminal-like UI components, handling announcements, sponsor images, and external links on a documentation webpage.

methods.name: setupTermynal
methods.description: Initializes terminal UI components with specific configurations.

methods.name: createTermynals
methods.description: Creates and configures individual terminal instances based on code blocks.

methods.name: loadVisibleTermynals
methods.description: Lazy loads terminal instances when they become visible in the viewport.

methods.name: shuffle
methods.description: Randomizes the order of elements in an array.

methods.name: showRandomAnnouncement
methods.description: Displays rotating announcements within a specified group at set intervals.

methods.name: handleSponsorImages
methods.description: Ensures sponsor images are loaded before displaying related announcements.

methods.name: openLinksInNewTab
methods.description: Modifies links to open external URLs in new tabs with security attributes.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point that initializes terminal setup, announcements, sponsor images, and link handling.
